pending_commit.commit_message: cr50-scripts: add Eve AP/EC RO hash database The AP range comes from src/mainboard/google/eve/chromeos.fmd in coreboot tree, RO VPD and the first 0xf000 bytes of the GBB space are excluded. The EC range comes from build/eve/firmware_image.lds generated when Eve EC image is built in the EC tree. There have been two Eve RO images in circulation, Google_Eve.9584.86.0 and Google_Eve.9584.107.0. Both MP images were extracted from their respective Chrome OS blobs (9964.0.0 and F10443.0.0) and processed by a helper Python script to generate SHA256 hashes of the RO areas. UPSTREAM: HID: usbhid: fix out-of-bounds bug The hid descriptor identifies the length and type of subordinate descriptors for a device. If the received hid descriptor is smaller than the size of the struct hid_descriptor, it is possible to cause out-of-bounds. In addition, if bNumDescriptors of the hid descriptor have an incorrect value, this can also cause out-of-bounds while approaching hdesc->desc[n]. So check the size of hid descriptor and bNumDescriptors. grunt: Boot BH720 SDHCI on nonzero strapping pins. Future versions of the Grunt reference board will have the eMMC device wired up to the BH720 SDHCI controller instead of the FT4's SDHCI pins. This change removes the FORCE_BH720_SDHCI config option and instead uses the device's strapping pins to decide if it should boot off of the BH720 or FT4's SDHCI controller. TEST=Booted on a board with BAYHUB_EN rework and strapping pin change.
